# Review — `review-203092263b34ce1f`
Targets: `3a6ce35e3549` and `37ef814e99dd`; both are reviewer-ready native parametric prototypes.
Source versions: `3a6ce35e3549` generator SHA-256 `c471b168ef0c135f156c246b07e5642ef8f2dcb61a79c1ca5a310c16d6759716`; `37ef814e99dd` repaired generator SHA-256 `24ec65df119526cf66d13e7744d5b023cada309dbcf8681616d235e57a1067e2` (v2.0.0).
`3a6ce35e3549`: exact canonical `blob` default plus episode-fixed `gaps`, with marker-derived crop bounds as the causal intermediate.
`37ef814e99dd`: repaired rectangle-only production/validator mismatch, then added exact canonical `all_objects` default plus `largest_only`.
Checks actually passed: 20 and 21 focused/task tests; target-2 native lint and self-check; two 32-seed bounded audits totaling 128 episodes and 1,280 pairs.
Protected authoring preflight passed four jobs and 40 Racket evaluations per target; source-bound causal witnesses replayed distinct counterfactual outputs.
Public projection passed for 16 one-query views per target, including 24 first-turn invariance checks and four positive controls each.
Reference-rule changes: none; both default Racket programs preserve the canonical program bytes exactly.
Remaining limits: finite seeds/rivals only; one broad target-2 aggregate battery and a combined rule-smoke run were interrupted and are not reported as passing.
Needs attention: owner source review, native qualification/acceptance, explicit resolution of the repaired target-2 audit after integration, and any training admission remain separate.

## `3a6ce35e3549`

The family identifies the four minority-color corner markers, derives the strict interior crop and source colors, then applies the episode-fixed `mask`. `blob` selects the majority-color shape and is the exact canonical default; `gaps` selects the complementary interior cells. A shifted-bounds Racket counterfactual proves that the inferred crop is used rather than decorative metadata.
